name: Foundry Loft
description: Warehouse conversion: one open volume, a raised sleeping platform, services in a corner block.

blueprint.layoutDescription: one open warehouse volume with no partitions across the main floor, so the kitchen, the dining table, the living area and a studio corner all share the same room with cast-iron columns down the middle, plus a sleeping platform five steps up behind a balustrade at one end and a small block holding a shower room and a utility room in the opposite corner

keywords: 140 square metre warehouse conversion with 4 metre ceilings
reclaimed red brick walls, dark stained plank floor
cast-iron columns, exposed steel and timber ceiling
tall black steel factory windows, deep sills
cluster pendant lamps, grey modular sofa, reclaimed timber shelving
warm raking side light, industrial but lived-in
anchor: Interior of a home, photographed at standing eye level
